title: Close out mdxpad and assure it works

questions.prompt: Which close-out lanes should this goal finish?
questions.description: The November 16 audit is the source. Recommended lanes are the real product and safety gaps. Stale spec checkboxes and the 400-line file splits are bookkeeping, not user-facing work.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Wire the shell, finish export, fix the editor and preview, harden file access, jail agent writes before mounting them, connect the already-built services, ship a safe collab slice, and make CI able to run.

options.label: Mount existing panels and command-palette entries
One export path, including compiled PDF and the other formats
Math on, WYSIWYG round-trip, and the four missing editor extensions
Confine file reads, file: navigation, CSP, and recovery durability
Reach git, search, import, citations, workspace, semantic search, and usage stats
Comments, share, and history with a real access check
Fix the pnpm CI pin so the suite can run
Rewrite stale spec checkboxes and split files over 400 lines

questions.prompt: How should collaboration ship in this close-out?
questions.description: The current socket accepts any document id and is never started. Yjs is not imported. Share-token checks have no production caller.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Ship comments, share links, and version history behind the existing token and path checks. Do not start an open realtime socket in this goal.

options.label: Guarded comments, share, and history. No open socket.
Also start a Yjs server, but only with a join token and a path jail.
Leave collaboration unmounted.

questions.prompt: What should happen to agent mode before a user can open it?
questions.description: The write tool runs immediately. path.resolve is not a workspace jail, and nothing asks for approval. The panel is not mounted today.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Jail writes to the workspace and require approval, then mount the panel. Leave it unmounted until both exist.

options.label: Jail and approval first, then mount agent mode
Mount chat only. Leave agent writes unregistered.
Leave both chat and agent mode unmounted

questions.prompt: What should the close-out do with unfinished cloud and marketplace providers?
questions.description: Only mock-cloud connects. Marketplace install always returns 'Marketplace not configured'.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Hide providers and marketplace install actions that are not implemented. Do not add a new cloud adapter in this goal.

options.label: Hide unfinished providers and the marketplace install action
Implement one real cloud adapter and a real marketplace catalog
Leave the current 'not implemented' errors in place

questions.description: node_modules is not installed on this machine yet. The latest main CI run failed in the pnpm setup step.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Install dependencies, fix the pnpm pin, and require typecheck, lint, and the unit suite. Add targeted tests for export, conflict Save As, file-read grants, and agent write confinement.

options.label: pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint
pnpm test
New tests for the lanes this goal changes
Playwright Electron e2e for the touched flows

questions.prompt: What should stay out even if a lane above is selected?
questions.description: Add a correction if the recommendation drops something you still want finished.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Dependabot major bumps beyond the pnpm pin, a second citation parser, and splitting every file over 400 lines.
